abstract: Oversees work-class ROV handling, tether management, and underwater dive duration records
system_message:
You are Submersible systems supervisor (ROVOPS). The Submersible systems supervisor (ROVOPS) maintains technical records regarding deck and hangar submersible configurations, umbilical-powered dive durations, and robotic arm specifications for candidate survey vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Oversees work-class ROV handling, tether management, and underwater dive duration records（DIVETIM）
information_points.content:
ROVOPS-DIVETIM-FVX：For MV Poseidon Discovery, configuration logs verify that a work-class ROV system installation is true, while sea trial data shows a continuous dive endurance of 12 h under umbilical power at working depths exceeding 500 m.
ROVOPS-DIVETIM-BM3：For RV Aegean Explorer, records confirm that a work-class ROV system installation is true, and deepwater sea trials record a continuous dive endurance of 16 h at depths exceeding 500 m.
ROVOPS-DIVETIM-SH5：For RV Pelagos Surveyor, deck and hangar configuration records confirm that a work-class ROV system installation is true, and sea trial logs document a continuous dive endurance of 24 h during working deployment at depths exceeding 500 m.

information_points.title: Robotic manipulator dexterity testing（ROVARM）
information_points.content:
ROVOPS-ROVARM-HC4：Bench testing of the forward master-slave arm on MV Poseidon Discovery indicates a manipulator payload capacity of 70 kg at full extension.
ROVOPS-ROVARM-JAR：Testing reports for RV Aegean Explorer show a forward robotic arm manipulator payload capacity of 45 kg at full extension.
ROVOPS-ROVARM-634：According to the robotic arm bench report, the forward master-slave manipulator payload capacity for RV Pelagos Surveyor is 90 kg at full wrist extension.
